matches.title: Tierlist of all HC + Evo Towers
matches.snippet: 9. Brawler. Decent for speedrunning. That's all. 8. Necromancer. Very map and mode dependent, great for HC, VC and PW2, but pretty useless besides that. 7. Accelerator. matches.title: Golden skin issue
matches.snippet: Golden skins are cool but the Way of unlocking them are insanely ass After I got golden demoman (basically the moment i noticed he dropped), I didn’t feel underwhelmed but for the potential price tag I had to pay, he did definitely feel pretty underpowered. Which can also be applied to 5/7 golden skins While the simpler option seems like to just reduce gold crate Price, I feel like it’ll just hinder on the exclusivity that the skincrate always had A better solution that’s been done in like every other roblox tower defense game with a similar progression like G towers, is removing the RNG aspect. Because imagine having an equal chance of getting golden soldier and getting golden minigunner for the heavy price of 34 frost games. Personally, implementing levels/tower evolution into golden towers doesn’t seem too far fetched of an idea, considering the original idea of tower evolutions and also how useless the 20 levels of the un evolved counter part are. My suggestion would be that after reaching level 10-30 (yes the level cap is changed for towers who already have evolutions) on un-golden towers, you can buy their golden counter part with varying price like on the daily skin shop, for example, after reaching level 30 on the minigunner, you csn buy the golden minigunner for 35k coins.Another example could be that after reaching level 15 on the cowboy, you can buy the golden cowboy

matches.title: Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop
matches.snippet: No seriously, it used to look like a good choice but now it just looks so incredibly grindy when other, actually viable evos came around. Jugg is quite literally just good for it's "DPS", which you have to pay half a million just to even make it a reasonable choice. It's not a bad tower, but it's heavily outclassed by other evos like Kingpin and the recent Enforcer. Not only that, but the "10k DPS" claim is sheer exaggeration. no one, especially a solo player where it's most efficient will have many supports, but even if they do get all the specs somehow, your loadout is literally just Juggernaut and Friends. You should not complain about the game, or modes in general being boring or "bad" if your playstyle is being Elon musk for 20 waves and placing Jugg. I don't hate Jugg. It's a good tower, but it's just incredibly brain-dead to use. saying your favourite tower is Jugg is the equivalent of saying "infinity + 1". Again, it's good for some hard modes like Voidcore. But I am not bringing jugg to play frost. Why juggernaut is doodoo DPS slop

Which can also be applied to 5/7 golden skins While the simpler option seems like to just reduce gold crate Price, I feel like it’ll just hinder on the exclusivity that the skincrate always had A better solution that’s been done in like every other roblox tower defense game with a similar progression like G towers, is removing the RNG aspect. Because imagine having an equal chance of getting golden soldier and getting golden minigunner for the heavy price of 34 frost games. Personally, implementing levels/tower evolution into golden towers doesn’t seem too far fetched of an idea, considering the original idea of tower evolutions and also how useless the 20 levels of the un evolved counter part are. My suggestion would be that after reaching level 10-30 (yes the level cap is changed for towers who already have evolutions) on un-golden towers, you can buy their golden counter part with varying price like on the daily skin shop, for example, after reaching level 30 on the minigunner, you csn buy the golden minigunner for 35k coins.Another example could be that after reaching level 15 on the cowboy, you can buy the golden cowboy

verified_top_matches.snippet: All Screenshots date to Version "Smaller = Bigger" in 2020. Outlaw (Now Ranger) Stacking in Old Badlands. Molten Difficulty I remember I was helping some folks get Cowboy. This was when Level affected HP, so our base health was a whopping 1,331 HP. Yes, back then the highest level was 867, and that was already absurd as my at-the-time Level of 154 was in itself considered high. Triumph on the heights. Just a standard fallen game on a map i really struggled with for some reason. Yes back then we were paid pocket change for these 32-40 minute games. You can also see the Old Enforcer (before he was changed to shotgunner) and the Twitter Minigunner on the background. Level 5 Golden Crook Boss with his beard shaven. You can see what he'd look like bearded in the background. Additionally, theres also the old Golden Crook unit which looked surprisingly boring. Funilly enough on his old models, one of the Tommy guns would have a drum mag while the other wouldn't. Interesting design choice for old Golden CB.
